record.question: What is the goal of antiretroviral therapy (ART) in HIV management?
options: To boost CD4+ T cell count
record.explanation: Official final key: B — To suppress viral replication. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 11, printed Q82. Source limitation: Options B, C, and D are all valid ART goals; no unique single answer is available. Add “all of the above” or ask specifically for the primary virologic goal. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
